rule.dateMin: Date must be on or after {{date}}
rule.dateMax: Date must be on or before {{date}}

inactive_days_threshold.label: Inactive days threshold
inactive_days_threshold.hint: Days without login before a reminder email is sent. Defaults to 7 when not configured

inactive_email_allowed_list.label: Reminder email allow list
inactive_email_allowed_list.hint: Only emails in this list receive reminders. Leave empty to send none

content_focus_outline_enabled.label: Content area outline
content_focus_outline_enabled.hint: On: show the black outline around the main content area when it is focused. Off: hide it. Defaults to off when not configured

outbox_retention_days.label: Outbox event retention (days)
outbox_retention_days.hint: Events already published to RabbitMQ are deleted after this many days (pending / failed events are kept). Leave empty or 0 to keep forever

work_email_fallback_to_login_name.label: Send work emails to the login email
work_email_fallback_to_login_name.hint: Work emails (approvals, reminders, notifications…) go to the work email. On: users without a work email receive them at their login email. Off or not set: those users are skipped. Account emails (OTP, password) always go to the login email

pdf_viewer.label: PDF viewer
pdf_viewer.hint: Built-in viewer (default): loads only the pages being read, so files open fast. OnlyOffice: loads the whole file first; use it when the built-in viewer renders a file incorrectly. Without OnlyOffice configured the built-in viewer is always used
